messages:
Priya K: FYI ArcWave just pushed a revisionwe lost 8 H100s from our April wave. They propose sending 6 replacements via air-RMA and the remainder as a ground consolidated pallet. Thoughts on accepting mixed routing?
Alex: Mixed routing = extra customs hops. If air units arrive on separate AWBs, each will incur a brokerage fee. Ask for per-AWB insurance and CN22/CIF split on paperwork.
Sara: Can Procurement push for vendor to pre-pay brokerage on DOA units? We should also insist on manifest photos for every unit pre-shipment. If they won't pay, we escalate to commercial credit.
Vik: Operational impact: accepting air-RMA split will speed capacity by ~48h but increases handling. If consolidated pallet adds 3-5d delay, we lose dedicated commit headroom. Can devops accept H200s as interim? Performance-wise ~30% lower FP16 perf on our gen-2 models.
Priya K: For acceptance: no temp serials. If ArcWave claims "placeholder IDs" we block receiving and open RMA hold. Require vendor-signed exception + photo of device label and manifest.
Procurement Team: Reached out to ArcWave; vendor offered to split brokerage 50/50 for this shipment only, and to absorb full brokerage if next-quarter commit goes ahead. Countered: we want them to cover brokerage for DOA replacements now, or provide a one-time credit.
Alex: Also request traceable AWB numbers now (not at ETA). We need HS codes per AWB for customs clearance. If they delay, we request a bonded transit option to avoid import duties until consolidated.
OpsBot: [automated] Created RMA ticket AWV-2026-1128. Suggested depot hold code: HOLD-PHOTO-MISMATCH. Estimated consolidated arrival: 2026-04-12.
Sara: Addendum: batch 4 had a manifest vs pallet count mismatch last week. We should add a mandatory pre-shipment QC step in vendor SLA: photo of each tray + manifest CSV (serial, SKU, HW rev). No exceptions.
Vik: Re routing plan: temporary mitigation - spin up 4x H200 nodes in eu-west to offload low-priority training. I'll coordinate scheduler policies. Note: inter-region egress costs ~= $0.09/token for large runs (est).
Priya K: Operational checklist snippet (for receiving):
```
- Confirm AWB list and HS codes before ship
- Receive vendor manifest + per-unit photos
- Reject placeholders; require vendor exception signed
- Tag DOA units with RMA ID (AWV-2026-1128)
- If split AWB, record brokerage invoice and escalate to procurement
```
Alex: If ArcWave insists on re-serializing at depot, we refuse. Re-serialization at vendor or depot without us present = unacceptable. Require live video sign-off if they claim re-serializing.
Procurement Team: Will push legal to add explicit clause for RMA brokerage and pre-shipment reconciliation to the addendum. Also requesting expedited AWB numbers.
Priya K: OK. Action items: Procurement to close brokerage ask and confirm vendor credit offer; Alex to update customs intake checklist; Vik to draft eu failover cost/latency estimate and ETA for job migration; Sara to update receiving runbook and add HOLD-PHOTO-MISMATCH flow.
Alex: Thanks. Keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
